item.title: North Korean Hackers Steal $6.3B from Binance
item.description: A North Korean cyber‑espionage group used months‑long social engineering to infiltrate Binance, stealing $6.3 billion in crypto and exposing gaps in industry security.

item.title: Hackers Steal $6.34B from Binance in 20‑Minute Heist
item.description: North Korean-linked hackers breached Binance’s internal tools, siphoning $6.34 billion in 20 minutes, exposing critical social‑engineering flaws across chains.
